hlog_convention.domain: z>0; real principal logarithms; no new complex continuation claimed

normalization.full_color_reduction: CF = CA^2*CF - 2*CA*CF^2; select a1 after full reduction

reassembly.method: reparse original completed global-IBP HyperInt coefficients, preserving wide coordinates

known_function_view.scope: individual finite coefficient; cancellation in the sum is a separate identity

Omega6.branch: z>0, ordinary convergent T6 at zero and real periods

period_definitions.A4: sum_{n>=1} (-1)^n*H_{n-1}/n^3 = integral_0^1 log(1/t)*log(1+t)^2/(2*t) dt = HyperInt zeta[1,-3]
period_definitions.A6: sum_{n>=1} (-1)^n*H_{n-1}/n^5 = integral_0^1 log(1/t)^3*log(1+t)^2/(12*t) dt = HyperInt zeta[1,-5]
